title: Fixed Offset Pin and Vertical Slot Yoke Display
description: One newly authored whole static direct-pin slotted-yoke-style display. A complete narrow tall frame has a genuine vertical through slot and two integral horizontal stems, passing through two whole bored guide pedestals on a common grounded bed. Behind that frame one entire circular crank disc carries a separate eccentric pin through the slot and a proud retaining head. A full rear spindle, genuinely bored bearing pedestal and retaining cap complete the assembly. Unlike the old crosshead drive, there is no piston cylinder, inclined two-eye connecting rod or separate flywheel; unlike the old indexing display there is no radial multi-slot wheel or second rotating shaft. All visible geometry newly authored, not old drive parts extracted or a carrier swapped. Four opaque constant PBR materials, metres, Z up and whole centred ground datum, one prop zero scenes. Fixed illustrative roots and clear openings only; no movement, travel envelope, crank-to-slider conversion, continuous engagement, bearing fit, mechanical ratio, torque, force, friction, manufacture, installation, load, operation or safety claim. Rigging, animation and interaction are not made.
